data.current_description:

Records send intent and reserves one of 512 shared delivery attempts per UTC day in the same transaction before authorizing mail. Retries consume this same budget. Returns only catalog links still active from the committed event; the list can be empty for an unlinked change or native observation. It does not send mail or grant tool approval. data.current_summary: Read a signed short-lived policy for this installation only.
data.current_description:
Private and no-store. Set ORIGIN to https://api.agentalog.com. Exact path, no query and no write. Revalidate credential expiry, revocation and account epoch on each read. Ed25519 signature; at most 500 rules, 1 MiB and 15 minutes, shortened to credential expiry. Client 0.4.0 pins the public key and verifies product/project/installation/epoch through its trusted connection. Reject expired, future, changed, differently scoped or older policies. An already cached policy can remain valid until expiry after an online revocation. policy downloads a signed decision. check recollects the selected configurations and target item before checking their exact candidates. The policy and check commands do not activate tools or install hooks. Optional hooks-install can install project hooks after preview consent. In enforce mode, covered calls require exact reviewed configuration and tool metadata. Removing a reviewed configuration prevents confirmation until that configuration is restored and reviewed. This does not freeze a remote MCP's code or guarantee universal blocking. Available only when the optional review service is configured.
Returns: { esquema, politica, assinatura }

Use this header to avoid duplicate counting on the client side.
